entities.name: Methyl 3-(2-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate
observations: Phenolic ester substrate; standardized SMILES: COC(=O)CCc1ccccc1O.

entities.name: Bis(chloromethyl)benzene
observations: Benzylic dihalide electrophile; represented as ClCc1cccc(CCl)c1, with positional isomer dependent on the encoded structure.

entities.name: Phenoxide benzylic O-alkylation
observations: Base-promoted Williamson ether synthesis/SN2: the ortho-phenoxide attacks one benzylic chloromethyl group, while the second chloromethyl group remains available for further derivatization.

entities.name: Methyl 3-(2-(chloromethylbenzyl)oxyphenyl)propanoate
observations: Likely major product; standardized representation: COC(=O)CCc1ccccc1OCc1cccc(CCl)c1. This is the mono-O-alkylated benzyl ether.
